execution.reason_for_split: The predecessor's 300-minute job completed the 50-update baseline but reached only seven history rows in its second case. The cases are independently run from fresh directories, and the baseline's immutable image receipt is preserved.
execution.same_image_pairing: The continuation is pairable with the archived completed baseline only after full measured image-receipt equality and frozen input equality are verified. Otherwise report the continuation as unpaired.
execution.completion_rule: Require exit 0, all 50 unique update IDs, exact reported old-time clock within the frozen 1e-12 tolerance, and preserved final fields/history/log. A partial run remains INCOMPLETE and is never accepted by the pair reviewer.

verdict_separation: velocity, energy, gradient-peak and vorticity-peak sampled quality thresholds
physical/source interpretation and continuous peak certification remain out of scope

stopping_rules: Do not start SU2 if the immutable image receipt differs from the completed baseline receipt.
Do not change the frozen prepared mesh, case configuration, CFL values, time step, inner cap, residual criterion, or quality thresholds.
Do not call a timeout a solver failure or a partial history a completed horizon.
Do not infer singularity, molecular alignment, particle-position certainty, or material-viscosity change from solver error.
